name:        useAnimatedLayout
domain:      hook
package:     @astryxdesign/core
import:      @astryxdesign/core/hooks
description: Returns a handle to pass to a component whose size changes, such as TreeList or Collapsible. When that component changes size, it and the content after it inside `containerRef` animate together on one shared motion role. Fixed and stuck sticky elements stay put, the glide never scrolls the area, and Reduce Motion is respected. It applies under every pointer, a mouse included. Without the handle a component keeps its jump: content after it takes its place at once. Content after the change may mix Astryx components and your own elements; none of it opts in.
command:     npx @astryxdesign/cli@0.7.12 hook useAnimatedLayout

name:        useAnimator
domain:      hook
package:     @astryxdesign/core
import:      @astryxdesign/core/hooks
description: Animates one element with the motion Astryx's own components use. Call `animator.animate` to spring an element to new values on the state-change motion, `animator.decay` to fling it with the momentum of a released scroll view, and `animator.set` to move it directly, so a card can follow a finger, snap back and be thrown away. To animate an area's layout as its items change, use `useAnimatedLayout`; for what a component already animates, such as a sheet's detents or a carousel's snapping, use the component's own props. Outside React, use `createAnimator`.
command:     npx @astryxdesign/cli@0.7.12 hook useAnimator

name:        useEntryAnimation
domain:      hook
package:     @astryxdesign/core
import:      @astryxdesign/core/hooks
description: Returns a StyleX style for animating an element on mount. Only animates when the element is dynamically inserted after the initial page paint; elements rendered on page load are not animated. Uses Astryx motion tokens (duration, easing) for consistent animation timing. Server-rendered elements hydrate without the entry style and never animate; elements mounted after hydration animate.
command:     npx @astryxdesign/cli@0.7.12 hook useEntryAnimation
